plan.title: Material PR to Award and PO

steps.note: Set the mandatory event title so it can be located later.
Commit the requested 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.

args.goal: add one Required T&C clause on the event create screen, save it, and stop when the create screen shows the clause as saved

steps.note: Add the required T&C clause, which has no dedicated catalog action.
Publish the Technical plus RFQ event.
Confirm publication reached a real project page.
Have the first invited vendor submit its technical response and RFQ quote at 100.
Verify the first vendor submission was accepted.
Have the second invited vendor submit its technical response and RFQ quote at 90.
Verify the second vendor submission was accepted.
Close the bidding window so technical evaluation and awarding can proceed.
Score and submit the technical responses as the assigned evaluator.
Open the buyer comparison grid after both bids and evaluation are complete.
Verify that two real vendor columns are shown in Master QCS.
Verify that the lower 90 bid ranks ahead of the 100 bid.
Award the complete event to the lowest-ranked vendor.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for the lowest evaluated bid.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required approver remark.
Complete PO creation from the approved award and read back the resulting purchase orders.
Verify that one PO contains the awarded PR line with the requested quantity.
Return to the events list to verify the completed event is in history.
Open the History tab for completed events.
Verify that this plan's event appears in event history.
